subject: words
title: Clever Words from the Forest
objective: Learn and use 6 new words from the Panchatantra: clever, forest, trick, friend, brave, share.

story_beats.text: Tara opens her sketchbook. 'The Panchatantra is full of clever animals — and clever WORDS! Let's collect six of them today.'
'First word: CLEVER. Clever means thinking of a smart idea. The rabbit was clever when he tricked the lion!'
'Now YOU try. I will show you three pictures — tap the one that shows something clever.'

options: A rabbit digging a tunnel to escape

interactions.prompt: BRAVE means not afraid to do the right thing. Who was brave?
options: The mouse who helped the lion

interactions.prompt: Say it with me: 'I can be clever AND kind!'

feedback.correct: Yes! You are collecting clever words like acorns!
feedback.retry: Good try! Listen again — clever means a SMART idea. Which picture shows a smart idea?

off_screen: Tonight, tell someone at home about one clever thing YOU did today.
parent_note: Vocabulary: clever, brave (+ forest, trick, friend, share in story). Listening + speaking.
